Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.14671

Status: **open** according to the source (as of March 2023). “Although Conjecture associated with median graphs is false, the conjecture on the resonance graphs of hexagonal systems (a subclass of median graphs) is still open.”
source_name: Yan-Ting Xie, Yong-De Feng and Shou-Jun Xu, “A relation between the cube polynomials of partial cubes and the clique polynomials of their crossing graphs”, arXiv:2303.14671 (2024).
statement:
Let $G$ be a median graph, and let $C(G,x)$ denote its cube polynomial.

**Zhang et al.'s conjecture.** The cube polynomial $C(G,x)$ is unimodal.

This conjecture is false: median graphs with non-unimodal cube polynomials are obtained, for example, from an $n$-cube with sufficiently many pendant vertices when $n\geqslant 9$.
title: Zhang et al.'s unimodality conjecture for cube polynomials of median graphs
